subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

On cloud nine
solution:
The correct answer is "**Extremely happy and excited"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **On cloud nine**: extremely happy.

 
 
• "I was **on cloud nine** once I had completed it"
 
 
 
• So, **Extremely happy and excited **is the best choice of our answer.
 
• Hence,** Option 1 **is the correct answer.
